# dokploy_ssh_keys (Data Source)

Fetches all SSH keys from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover SSH key IDs for importing existing resources.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_ssh_keys" "all" {}

# Output all SSH key IDs for import discovery
output "ssh_key_ids" {
  value = { for k in data.dokploy_ssh_keys.all.ssh_keys : k.name => k.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ssh_keys` (Attributes List) List of all SSH keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the SSH key.
- `description` (String) The description of the SSH key.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSH key.
- `last_used_at` (String) The last used timestamp of the SSH key.
- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the SSH key belongs to.
- `public_key` (String) The public key.
